payload.friendly_name: Pack Dashboard — Domain Tags and Built-in Doctrine
payload.purpose_context: This mission advances Pack Dashboard — Domain Tags and Built-in Doctrine on overhaul/migrate_to_kitty so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.
payload.purpose_tldr: Add functional domain tagging for artifacts and surface spec-kitty built-in doctrine in the pack governance dashboard

payload.question: Should untagged artifacts surface a dashboard warning ('X artifacts have no domain tag')?

payload.rationale: Engineering note recommends this be optional/feature-flagged. Decision deferred to implementation phase to avoid premature adoption pressure during early roll-out.
